Implement Flutter authentication models and HTTP API client service:

   - Class AuthTokens with final String accessToken, tokenType, email; final int? userId;
   - fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) and toJson() methods.
2. mobile/lib/features/auth/services/auth_api_service.dart:
   - Class AuthApiService with baseUrl (default 'http://localhost:8080/api/auth' or configurable).
   - Future<AuthTokens> register({required String email, required String password, String? firstName, String? lastName})
   - Future<AuthTokens> login({required String email, required String password})
